description: The chart in Figure 3 illustrates the results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev, comparing the performance of three modules across three metrics. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Recall", "Precision", and "F1 Score", in that order. The vertical axis is labeled with a scale ranging from 40 to 100, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20. The chart features grouped bars, with each group representing a metric and containing three bars corresponding to "TA-SQL (zero-shot)", "DIN-SQL (zero-shot)", and "DIN-SQL (few-shot)", colored in dark blue, light blue, and light green, respectively. For "Recall", the bars have approximate values of 71.90, 63.58, and 72.29; for "Precision", the values are 91.24, 88.89, and 92.31; and for "F1 Score", the values are 80.40, 75.34, and 81.08. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
